violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Quaternary Ammonium Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the quaternary ammonium compound-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the Sanitizer bucket and 3-compartment sink with a concentration of 100 ppm total quaternary ammonium compound.
violations.corrective_action: The quaternary ammonium sanitizer used in this facility shall have a minimum concentration of at least 200 ppm OR a concentration between 150-400ppm based on the manufacturer's use directions and using the appropriate test kit. CFM prepare new sanitizer in the 3- compartment sink and sanitizer buckets.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. Observed employee putting on new gloves without washing his hands.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS provided education on proper handwashing, and CFM communicated this to the employees. The employee washed his hands before putting on new gloves.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed wet wiping clothes on a dry bucket.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. CFM prepared a sanitizer bucket and store the wet wiping towels

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: Observed soda and water dispenser soiled.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized.CFM cleaned the nozzles and the water dispenser surfaces. CFM will Wash, rinse, and sanitize all components thoroughly using approved food-safe sanitizer. Ensure the cleaning schedule is being followed and documented.
